name: drive dired interactively
comment: The start -> act -> wait -> observe loop against a built-in package (works offline). $HOME is the sandbox's fake home, so the fixture files never touch the real one.

steps.eval: (progn (make-directory "~/demo" t) (with-temp-file "~/demo/notes.txt" (insert "remember the milk")) (with-temp-file "~/demo/todo.org" (insert "* TODO buy milk")) t)
steps.comment: fixture files inside the sandbox home
real keys work too; this script drives point with dired's own commands instead:
act: move point onto the file
act: visit it, exactly like a user pressing RET
